input.quote: Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement,
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination fee payable by AP, which meets the preferred position (no Customer-payable LDs). Section 4(a) lets either Party terminate for convenience after the Initial Term on 90 days' notice; Kubient's entitlement to "all fees generated during the termination period" is simply its share of revenue actually generated while the Services continue during the notice period under the revenue-share in Section 5, not a fixed termination payment or stipulated damages amount. Section 5 is a revenue-share running from Kubient to AP (AP pays only applicable taxes), and there are no minimum-fee or shortfall commitments (Section p0062 expressly disclaims any minimum revenue guarantee). Nothing in the document requires AP to pay a penalty or stipulated sum on termination or breach, so no redline is warranted.
